what: of3t-orchestrator pass 389: the sub-module partition is ENTAILED, and one of my own hypotheses dies here.
why_no_aiclk: CPU only, no Tenstorrent device is opened; nothing here is a timing

THE_PARTITION_IS_ENTAILED.measured_premise: TWOBASIS.json -- the z-only arm's ds_in is exactly 0.0, so the pair track does not read the single track
THE_PARTITION_IS_ENTAILED.therefore: s-branch parameters reach the loss ONLY through cot_s and pair-branch parameters reach it through both, so a defect in cot_z and nothing else produces exactly this partition at every depth with no mechanism at the pair branch
THE_PARTITION_IS_ENTAILED.so_ps_dropout_row_layer_matching_it_is_w: every structure that distinguishes the two branches matches the partition. The row refuted dropout on its own merits, which was right; the point here is that the partition could not have nominated it in the first place.
THE_PARTITION_IS_ENTAILED.what_the_split_IS_worth: a consistency check that passes -- 11 attn_pair_bias + 5 single_transition = 16 exact tensors per block, times 48, is exactly TWOBASIS's 768 s-only class.
THE_PARTITION_IS_ENTAILED.and_the_blockprobe_is_the_passs_real_res: the reference gradient was the one quantity never read twice; a second instrument now puts it at 3.0392623414001263e-15 (block 47) and 4.1031090433915236e-15 (block 46), at the two blocks where the replay is worst.

MY_OWN_HYPOTHESIS_REFUTED.what_I_expected: that the two-scalar fit is collinear (cos 0.9181952 between the regressors) and its b_z therefore meaningless, so that the '7x too large' headline was a fitting artifact
MY_OWN_HYPOTHESIS_REFUTED.verdict: REFUTED. b_z = 0.55, which is what a 1.8x scale error would mean, costs residual 0.173577 against the minimum's 0.111621 -- 55 % worse. The published b_z stands.

reconstruction_check.why_it_matters: solving the 2x2 normal equations from banked scalars alone reproduces the row's fit to 2e-14, so this file's arithmetic is checked and so is the row's.

THE_1_8x_AND_THE_7x_ARE_THE_SAME_STATEME.per_submodule_reading: 1.78 to 2.02 at block 47, 1.567 to 2.203 over all four probed blocks, tightening to 1.781-1.835 at block 0
THE_1_8x_AND_THE_7x_ARE_THE_SAME_STATEME.read: the correction applies only to the cot_z PART of a pair parameter's gradient, and that part is a large fraction of the total, so a ~7x overshoot on the part shows up as ~1.8x on the whole. Nothing is in conflict.

WHAT_A_MECHANISM_NOW_HAS_TO_EXPLAIN.magnitude: cot_z's contribution wants scaling by about 0.14 (least squares) to 0.038 (norm match on the pair class), i.e. 7x to 26.1x too large
WHAT_A_MECHANISM_NOW_HAS_TO_EXPLAIN.direction: and about ten degrees, not more. The pair-branch cos is 0.948834 to 0.998232 and 0.995 at depth, which is a 0.0999 perpendicular component -- the same size as the 0.111621 residual floor after the best two scalars.
WHAT_A_MECHANISM_NOW_HAS_TO_EXPLAIN.so_the_rows_phrase_pointing_elsewhere_ov: the irreducible residual is a ~10 % perpendicular component, not a different direction. A mechanism must produce a large magnitude error and a small angle on the z channel only, which is a much tighter target than the phrase suggests.

AND_MY_PASS_387_DISCRIMINATOR_IS_STILL_U.what_blockprobe_did: torch.autograd.grad(LOSS, params) on the original graph -- loss-driven. That confirms the reference and is not the discriminator.
AND_MY_PASS_387_DISCRIMINATOR_IS_STILL_U.what_is_still_owed: torch.autograd.grad(outputs=(s_out, z_out), grad_outputs=(cot_s, cot_z), inputs=...) on the ORIGINAL graph -- cotangent-driven. Same graph, so the only remaining structural difference from the replay is which drive is used.
AND_MY_PASS_387_DISCRIMINATOR_IS_STILL_U.and_it_now_costs_about_135_s: blockprobe already prunes the graph to one block (measured 135.2 s against a 340.6 s forward) and capture_model_frame.py:653-656 already holds s_out_t and z_out_t for exactly this. It is one extra grad_outputs= argument.
AND_MY_PASS_387_DISCRIMINATOR_IS_STILL_U.falsifier_unchanged: dL/dz_in at 0.000848887340907281 means the replay's fresh forward is the defect; at 0.0014907294032500784 means the injection overcounts on the original graph too.

DOESNOT: this names no mechanism and moves no published number. It removes a class of dead ends, kills one hypothesis of my own, reconciles two readings that looked contradictory, and states the target a mechanism has to hit.
